sources.title: Observatory Visitor Information | Tokyo Metropolitan Government Bureau of Finance
facts: The official search excerpt distinguishes north and south observatories and describes views over Tokyo from 202 meters.
It states a civic-learning purpose and locates the public piano in the south observatory.
limitations: The open returned the official title and page metadata without substantive page lines; facts above were inspected in the official search excerpt.
The available information does not resolve north-observatory cultural or modern-art programming.
